instruction: Configure Chrome to ensure that the minimum font size for all websites is 12 pixels for better readability.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting minimum font size in Chrome to exactly 12 pixels to ensure readability for users with vision issues. Evaluator checks if minimum_font_size == 12. Uses custom getter to extract minimum_font_size from Chrome preferences and custom metric to validate the exact value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts minimum_font_size from Chrome preferences file (webkit.webprefs.minimum_font_size) across all OS platforms
Metric correctly compares extracted font size against expected value using proper parameter handling for type='rule'
Expected value of 12 pixels exactly matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted and readable from preferences file
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (set min font to 12px) and evaluator checks exactly this
Data flow is correct: getter extracts numeric value, metric receives it and compares against expected numeric value
Error handling present: getter returns 0 on failure, which would correctly fail the verification
